Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1628465. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
